edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. Former 等分, 等分ᴷ and 踱 stay as reverse-only aliases in current; no intermediate edition.

rationale.approved: 2026-11-08 direct user adoption mitoz=丝分, kariokinez=丝分ᴷ and subsequent explicit confirmation ambl=对侧步. 丝 refers to thread-like chromosomes and established 有丝分裂, 分 to division; original 等分 remains a valid description, not an error. Both synonymous roots move together, retaining bare mitoz and kariokinez identifier k. ambl means the same-side pair gait, not general slow pacing; 对侧步 follows the Chinese equestrian term and reduces one dedicated character 踱 despite 16-to-20 stroke growth. Total body strokes 48 to 38, character types 2218 to 2217, no new CJK character. Existing late-added kariokinez P=5 reservation is preserved. Original dictionary text, segmentation, glosses, markers, annotations and fixed legacy edition remain unchanged. Current inverse may retain 等分, 等分ᴷ and 踱 as aliases without adding an intermediate edition.

migration_notice: Only current mitoz/kariokinez/ambl change. Former full keys remain in reverse CSV and indexes. Fixed legacy, identifiers and root segmentation stay unchanged.
